desc:
Build a house brick by brick, rent it out and become the richest landlord on the street!

Handyman: Build & Rent is a building tycoon where YOU do the real work. Lay the foundation, stack every brick, plaster the walls, put in windows and floors - then hand the keys to a tenant and collect rent.

HOW TO PLAY
- Talk to tenants on Willow Street and make a deal
- Build every wall by hand, brick by brick
- Plaster, fix and renovate until it's perfect
- Finish the building and earn passive rent income
- Build the next house and grow your street

FEATURES
- Satisfying build and renovation simulator
- Real bricklaying and plastering - no instant buttons
- Rent tycoon: your buildings earn money for you
- Grow from a handyman to a rich landlord

Build to rent, build to earn, build to get rich!
Like and Favorite to get new buildings and updates!
